purpose: Directional evidence for Türkiye-first addressable commerce-platform reach. Not an additive TAM, market-share, active-paid-merchant or unique-merchant estimate.
rules: Do not add platform counts together: merchant/account overlap is unknown.
Preserve each provider's own metric label and definition.
A vendor marketing count is provider-reference evidence, not independently audited market share.
Do not convert 'users', 'active users', 'brands', 'customers', 'sites' or 'projects' into one common unit without evidence.
Use counts directionally for connector/commercial reach prioritization together with API feasibility, merchant fit, competition, support burden and evidence access.

official_claims.raw_claim: 30,000+ brands / more than 30,000 businesses; 30,000+ customers worldwide
official_claims.current_reference: official Ticimax homepage and 2025 team.blue acquisition announcement
official_claims.interpretation: Current vendor-reference scale is consistently 30,000+. Global/customer/brand wording varies; uniqueness and active-paid status are not independently verified.

official_claims.metric_label: businesses / e-commerce sites / customers (broad historical/current vendor base)
official_claims.current_reference: official IdeaSoft references, homepage and about pages
official_claims.interpretation: Current broad vendor-base claim. It may include historical customers and is not equivalent to currently active app-store-addressable sites.
More directly relevant to app distribution but appears on an older app-store surface. Preserve separately; do not overwrite with or add to the 50,000+ broad customer/site claim.
Current active-use vendor claim; closest ikas metric to installed active base.

official_claims.raw_claim: 100,000+ users; 100,000+ people created a Start-package e-commerce site in six months
official_claims.current_reference: official ikas packages page and 2026 ikas news article
official_claims.interpretation: Broader acquisition/account/site-creation metric, materially larger than active users. Do not treat as active merchants or sum with 20,000+ active users.

official_claims.raw_claim: No exact current total customer/site count located on official public pages after bounded search.
official_claims.current_reference: official T-Soft ecommerce, systems, contact and partner pages
official_claims.interpretation: Total installed base remains UNKNOWN; do not infer a numeric total from reference logos, support language or qualitative scale wording.
Known subset/service metric only. It is a lower-bound signal for one T-Soft service and cannot be used as total T-Soft merchant count.

cross_platform_conclusion.directional_result: Current official claims show individually material Türkiye-first ecosystems: Ticimax 30,000+ brands/businesses, IdeaSoft 50,000+ broad businesses/sites/customers with a separately stated 18,000+ active Appstore-site surface, and ikas 20,000+ active users alongside a broader 100,000+ user/site-creation metric. T-Soft total public count remains unknown; 397+ e-export brands is only a non-comparable subset.
cross_platform_conclusion.priority_implication: Evidence supports Türkiye-first connector priority and a multi-platform value proposition, but does not authorize a summed TAM or unique-merchant estimate. Connector sequence must still combine reach with API feasibility, provider-authentic evidence, merchant fit, competitive substitution, implementation/support burden and commercial validation.
